column1: # Non-apt root programs that owe source, for scripts/plan-sources.sh (docs/legal.md#source-images).
# apt packages need no entry: every copyleft or non-machine-readable apt package in manifest.tsv
# is a root of its own, fetched from the repository listed in scripts/source-apt.tsv.
#   root, kind, repository, ref, covers, recipe, note
#   git       ref: tag pattern, {version} = the main module's version in manifest.tsv.
#             covers: "go-module:<main module>" then the binaries built from it; their Go modules
#             in manifest.tsv must all be vendored in the source image.
#             recipe: go-vendor (run `go mod vendor`) or vendored (the repository commits vendor/).
#   bundle    ref: tag pattern, {version} = the first covered component's version.
#             covers: components (globs). Copyleft ones whose manifest source is "source:<url>
#             sha256:<hex>" are downloaded as archives; the rest come from the git subpaths.
#             recipe: sparse=<path>,<path>: the subpaths exported from the repository.
#   gap       A copyleft component whose source can't be produced yet; note says why. Reported,
#             not fatal, so it stays visible until it's resolved (docs/legal.md#open-questions).
